statement: Admin control snapshots share their existing repair and durable-publication diagnostic helpers and separate per-partition CDC projection from aggregation, preserving diagnostic outputs and read-only behaviour while satisfying the existing source duplication and complexity publication ratchets.

constraints.statement: Consolidate the existing AdminControlSnapshot diagnostic implementation. Preserve output shapes, getter order and count, exceptions, publication evidence precedence and read-only behaviour. Do not introduce runtime authority, a supervisor, retries or wider deadlines.

Limit runtime edits to admin-control-snapshot.js, admin-control-snapshot-node-view-projection.js and admin-control-snapshot-local-diagnostics-methods.js. Reuse existing canonical helpers and keep touched source files within the 800-line limit.
Run the existing whole-corpus complexity and duplication checkers. Do not increase their baselines or exclude measured code. Tighten a baseline only when its checker reports the lower measurement.

Retain the current-candidate red measurements, independently verify equivalent diagnostic behaviour and run the affected admin and autonomous-handoff tests through classified lab placement. This does not admit H1, physical formation or release acceptance.
